identity.name: Submariner Date
identity.one_liner: The 2010-2020 Submariner Date that brought the ceramic bezel and maxi case to the standard black Sub.

provenance_events.description: The 116610LN is the last "Maxi" 40mm ceramic Submariner Date, with caliber 3135, running 2010-2020. After it, the line moves to 41mm with the 126610LN.

narrative.story: The 116610LN replaced the 16610 in 2010, adding a Cerachrom bezel, a Glidelock clasp, and the broad-shouldered 'Super Case' with fat lugs and wider crown guards. A full decade as the default luxury dive watch made it one of the most-produced modern Rolex references, and it is the entry point many collectors use for the ceramic era.
narrative.collector_notes: Plentiful on the secondary market, so buy on condition and completeness. The thick lugs make past polishing easy to spot — check the chamfers.
